items.purpose: An amendment to strike all after the enacting clause and insert a new text entitled "Nicholas Dockery Medal of Honor Act".

dimensions.assessment: Applies to exactly one individual, Nicholas Dockery.
dimensions.evidence: to award the Medal of Honor to Nicholas Dockery

dimensions.assessment: Confers a prestigious military decoration to an individual who previously received the Silver Star.
dimensions.evidence: for the acts of valor described in subsection (b).

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue changes are stated or implied.
Grants a one-time statutory exception to time limitations for a specific military medal award.
dimensions.evidence: Notwithstanding the time limitations specified in section 7274 of title 10, United States Code

dimensions.assessment: One-time action with permanent individual recognition.

missing_information: Cost estimates or fiscal impact are not mentioned.
importance_detail.rationale: This private bill authorizes the President to award the Medal of Honor to a single individual, Nicholas Dockery, for specific acts of valor in 2012.
